name: Query creator info
description: Queries the authenticated creator's info and current posting options. Returns the account's available `privacy_level_options` and interaction settings (comment/duet/stitch), which the Content Posting API requires you to read before a direct post — the valid `privacy_level` values for an account are only discoverable here. Call this to pick a real privacy level instead of guessing (unaudited apps only ever get SELF_ONLY).

input_parameters.title: QueryCreatorInfoRequest
input_parameters.description: The endpoint takes no parameters — the creator is resolved from the token.

CreatorInfoData.title: CreatorInfoData

duet_disabled.title: Duet Disabled
duet_disabled.description: True if duets are disabled (or the account is private).

stitch_disabled.title: Stitch Disabled
stitch_disabled.description: True if stitches are disabled (or the account is private).

comment_disabled.title: Comment Disabled
comment_disabled.description: True if commenting is disabled for this creator.

creator_username.title: Creator Username
creator_username.description: Unique username of the TikTok creator.

creator_avatar_url.title: Creator Avatar Url
creator_avatar_url.description: URL of the creator's avatar, with a 2-hour TTL.

privacy_level_options.title: Privacy Level Options
privacy_level_options.description: Privacy levels this account may currently post with (e.g. SELF_ONLY, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE). Pass one of these as privacy_level when publishing. For unaudited apps only SELF_ONLY is returned.

max_video_post_duration_sec.title: Max Video Post Duration Sec
max_video_post_duration_sec.description: Maximum video length in seconds this creator may post.
